reason: Retain the measured 68-file confinement test directory. Shared admission, filesystem policy, floor contracts such as the key-material store floor, and applied platform boundaries stay beside their existing probe process and grant fixtures. Metadata and standard-stream contracts are two live suites under the same real command launch; they cover outside-root EROFS, exact allow-backs, original mount flags, unchanged source metadata, byte delivery, the null stream for closed input and descendant cleanup. The original-mount-flag contract joined the metadata suite rather than adding a file when the key-material floor contract arrived. The shared Linux probe remains bounded while new concerns have their own suites. Repackaging these tests would expose internal setup without creating a new authority boundary.
